description: Bring app update operations to the same maturity as install/backup/restore by requiring pre-update backups, recording known-good refs, running health gates, and offering rollback when an update fails.

timing.plannedEarliestExecution: After backup/restore UX and health visibility are reliable
timing.gatingCondition: Requires health/readiness probes and backup metadata to be trustworthy enough to gate updates.

principles: No app update without a backup
Rollback should be available without shell improvisation
Start with refs/commits before release-channel polish

techStack.runtime: git, npm/python app bootstrap, systemd, nginx, PostgreSQL restore
techStack.storage: SQLite rollback/update records plus existing jobs/backups/installations
techStack.testing: Planner tests, dry-run endpoint tests, manual VM update/rollback rehearsal

userStories.title: Update requires and records a pre-update backup
acceptanceCriteria: Update action is unavailable or blocked until a pre-update backup can be created
Update job records previous ref, target ref, backup id, and service name
userStories.testStrategy: Planner tests and API dry-run tests

userStories.title: Health-gated update execution
acceptanceCriteria: Update fetches target ref, installs dependencies, runs migrations/bootstrap, restarts service
Post-update health/readiness must pass before job is marked completed
Failures preserve enough state for rollback
userStories.testStrategy: Manual VM update to known ref plus simulated health failure

userStories.title: Rollback restores previous known-good state
acceptanceCriteria: Rollback action is visible after failed or completed update with rollback metadata
Rollback restores prior ref and selected backup where needed
Rollback has its own health gate and job log
userStories.testStrategy: Manual VM rollback rehearsal using Family Help or Family Dinner

high: Rollback that restores code but not data can create false confidence
Migrations may not be reversible across app repos
medium: Update commands differ across Node/Python apps
Health checks must be trustworthy before gating updates
low: Can start with one or two simple apps before suite-wide support

preFlightChecklist: Choose first supported app for update/rollback rehearsal
Confirm backup artifact completeness for rollback target app
